schema.description: Merged mapping from your news-type taxonomy (L2, genre-only after consolidation) to a merged IPTC Genre-style set (L1). Design goals: (1) one-to-one mapping from every L2 to exactly one L1, (2) no empty L1 buckets, (3) remove topic-like L2 labels by merging them into genre labels, and (4) keep L2 compact and annotation-stable for news-domain texts.

l2_consolidation_notes.rationale: science_technology behaves as a topic label rather than a genre label; to keep L2 genre-only and enable unique mapping, it is merged into analysis_explainer (explainer/analysis bucket).

L1_definitions.Current: Time-sensitive reporting focused on recent or ongoing events (straight news / current events).
L1_definitions.Feature: Longer-form, narrative or human-interest reporting not primarily driven by immediate timeliness (includes many soft, lifestyle/culture features).
L1_definitions.Special_Report: In-depth or investigative reporting requiring extensive research and evidence gathering, often a deep dive on a single subject.
L1_definitions.Attribution_QA: Interview content presented primarily via explicit attribution, especially Q&A structure (questions/answers or direct quoted exchanges).
L1_definitions.Opinion: Authorial viewpoint/editorial stance aimed at persuasion, normative judgment, or advocacy.
L1_definitions.Background_Analysis: Explainer/analysis content that provides background, synthesis, interpretation, or causal reasoning (merged to avoid ambiguity between background vs analysis).
L1_definitions.Profile_Biography: Person-centered narrative describing the life/activity of a subject based on facts, research, and/or interviews (merged to avoid ambiguity between profile vs biography).
L1_definitions.Review: Critique/evaluation of creative works, services, products, or consumer experiences (reviews/criticism).
L1_definitions.Satire: Humor/irony/exaggeration intended as satire; not meant to be interpreted as factual reporting.
L1_definitions.Unspecified: Fallback bucket for noisy, mixed, or out-of-scope items that do not reliably fit the above genres.

L2_definitions.hard_news: Straight factual reporting centered on concrete events and attributable actions, typically time-sensitive and actor/event-driven.
L2_definitions.feature_investigative: Investigation or deep-dive reporting that builds an evidence trail (documents, multiple sources) and develops a broader narrative.
L2_definitions.profile_biography: Person-centered reporting describing an individual's life, background, and activity with narrative structure.
L2_definitions.interview_QA: Interview presented primarily as a sequence of questions and answers or explicit attributed dialogue.
L2_definitions.opinion_editorial: Editorial/opinion writing emphasizing stance, persuasion, and normative judgment rather than neutral reporting.
L2_definitions.analysis_explainer: Explainers and analyses synthesizing facts with background, interpretation, or causal reasoning (also absorbs prior science_technology topic label).
L2_definitions.soft_news: Soft reporting with lighter timeliness constraints, often human-interest oriented and less event-urgent than hard news.
L2_definitions.lifestyle_culture: Lifestyle/culture feature-style reporting (arts, culture, leisure) typically experiential or community-facing.
L2_definitions.review_criticism: Reviews/criticisms evaluating products, services, cultural works, or consumer experiences.
L2_definitions.satire_humor: Humorous or satirical content using irony/exaggeration to make a point; not intended as literal factual reporting.
L2_definitions.other_misc: Miscellaneous or noisy items that do not reliably fit the above categories.
